headline: Newcastle's Matthias Jaissle: 'I don't care' about outside negativity
description: Matthias Jaissle told his detractors he does not care about their opinions amid a wave of negativity for his Newcastle side ahead of the start of the new season.

headline: Hull chairman hits out at 'laughable' Joe Cole criticism
description: Hull City chairman Acun Ilicali has criticised former players Joe Cole and Carlton Cole for mocking the club's Premier League survival chances.

headline: Michael Carrick: 'Ridiculous' to say Man United have easy start
description: Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick has hit back at suggestions that Manchester United have been given a favourable start to the Premier League season.

headline: Liverpool have £50 million bid for Yankuba Minteh rejected by Brighton - sources
description: Liverpool have had a £50 million ($68m) bid for Brighton & Hove Albion's Yankuba Minteh rejected, sources told ESPN.

headline: Frank Lampard expects 'tougher times' for Coventry on return to Premier League
description: Coventry boss Frank Lampard said his side need to be ready for "tougher times" this season ahead of their Premier League curtain-raiser against champions Arsenal on Friday.

headline: Manchester City in talks with Palmeiras for winger Allan Elias - sources
description: Manchester City are in talks over a deal for Palmeiras winger Allan Elias, sources have told ESPN.
